Nicole built four apps before turning 25, hit 150K MRR with her first one out of her college bedroom, and scaled Sprout to 250K MRR while generating 100 million monthly views through a creator system she built from scratch. In this episode, she breaks down the exact playbooks behind every app she's built, from the viral referral mechanics and onboarding sequences that drove millions of downloads, to the UGC creator machine that now produces hundreds of millions of views every week.

This is one of the most detailed breakdowns of consumer app growth you'll find anywhere. We get into the TikTok content formulas that kept working, how tripling the price actually increased conversion, the paywall flow decisions that led to a 50% lift, and why 90% of what Nicole learned came from downloading apps herself, not from Twitter.

If you're building a consumer app or just want to understand how the best growth operators actually think, this one is worth your full attention.
